_comment: Example configuration. Copy to config.json (or point STRUCTURA_CONFIG at a copy). Values in custom_config are documented in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md. Environment variables MONGO_ADDRESS, MONGO_USERNAME, MONGO_PASSWORD, MONGO_DATABASE and MONGO_TLS override the mongo_* keys. Do not commit real credentials.

custom_config._mongo_username: Application user. Prefer env MONGO_USERNAME; empty means no authentication.
custom_config._mongo_password: Prefer env MONGO_PASSWORD. Special characters are percent-encoded automatically.
custom_config._mongo_tls: true adds tls=true to the connection (or set env MONGO_TLS=true). Default false.
custom_config._allowed_origins: Browser origins that may call the API (CORS), exact match, e.g. https://app.example.com. Empty: no CORS headers are sent.
custom_config._trusted_proxies: IP addresses of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted. Default [127.0.0.1].
custom_config._session_idle_seconds: A session expires after this time without a request. Default 3600.
custom_config._login_max_failures_per_user: Failed logins per user within the window before /login answers 429. Default 5.
custom_config._login_failure_window_seconds: Window for the per-user failure limit. Default 900.
custom_config._login_max_requests_per_ip: Login requests per client IP within the window. Default 20.
custom_config._login_ip_window_seconds: Window for the per-IP limit. Default 60.
